note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week. The log is a sample of named events (only 9 of more than 70 boat strikes are logged one by one) and nothing is logged after Oct 27, 2026.
headline: On Oct 27 the US struck a boat in the eastern Pacific and killed five, SOUTHCOM said, without showing evidence it carried drugs; AP puts the campaign toll at at least 240 dead in more than 70 strikes (#4067). The strike before it in the log was on Oct 4 (#4064).

Rubio said on Oct 14 that a new round of negotiations on Venezuela's future had begun, the same day the US lifted sanctions on National Assembly head Jorge Rodriguez (#4066). Opposition leader Maria Corina Machado returned to Venezuela on Oct 25; Rubio credited US-supported reconciliation talks (not logged; not confirmed as US-Venezuela talks).
The judge in the Maduro case, Alvin Hellerstein, died on Oct 28; no replacement has been named (not logged). The last logged step in the case is the Oct 8 torture charge (#4065).
No Venezuelan hostile act (an attack, harassment of US assets or a mobilization) is logged since Nov 2025, and no new US deployment is logged in 2026.
Small numbers: most options have only a handful of counted cases, and options F and G are too thin to measure.
